items.html: And now one must know, then in what way the phases of the Tzelems of the Mochin of the pregnancy differ from those of the nursing, or from those of the second pregnancy of Gadlut, both in the phase of the Mochin themselves and in the phase of their garments, which are Tevuna or Yeshsut. And the matter is as said, that every Sefira has in it three phases of vessels: external, middle, and internal. And corresponding to them are three kinds of lights that clothe within them, and they are: Nefesh in the external vessel, Ruach in the middle vessel, and Neshama in the internal vessel.
